sky.note: our own stars and moon are in the faces; the afterglow is in Ft, up the street (-Z). A day clock in both phases: at a night clock Roblox darkens a custom sky.

sun.note: the one directional light, high and from behind the player walking in, so the fight is lit the same from either end; `toward` is the unit vector to it with the street running to -Z

ambient.note: a flat fill, Ambient and OutdoorAmbient alike; `asOne` is colour times strength

atmosphere.note: Color is the haze toward the street's far end, Decay the haze back toward the gate; `hazeAt` is how much of a thing the haze has taken at that many studs in these frames

glow.note: EmissiveStrength for the kit's pieces and for the two floors, as these frames have them

pools.note: the SpotLight over each pack, the square's and the gate's (the plan's lights), Shadows off

lead.note: one PointLight carried by the lead: `ahead` studs toward his target, `up` studs over the ground, under the hat's height
